999008199.text:
うう……夜の砂漠は冷えるといいますが、
だいぶ寒くなりましたね

localizations.en: Ugh... They say the desert gets cold at night, and it's really gotten chilly now.

999008199.text:
まあ、今がこらえ時だよ。なんせ悪事を働く輩は、
人通りの少ない夜を好むからね

localizations.en: Well, this is when we need to tough it out. Criminals prefer to work at night when there are fewer people around, after all.

999008199.text:
それにしてもエルスは一人で別行動とか
大丈夫なの？

localizations.en: Even so, is Els really okay going off on her own like that?

999008199.text:
ボスに限っては大丈夫だと思います。
それに、今は街中も警戒しなきゃですから

localizations.en: I think she'll be fine. Besides, we need to keep watch over the city too.

999008199.text:
確かに……
実際にイザナが攫われかけたわけだものね

localizations.en: True... Izana almost got kidnapped, after all.

999008199.text:
加えて今頃は武道会の真っ最中だろう？
会場以外の警備が手薄な分、街中での犯行が怖いのさ

localizations.en: Plus the tournament's in full swing right now, right? With security stretched thin everywhere else, we've got to worry about crimes happening throughout the city.

999008199.text:
ふーん、なんとなく分かる気がするわ。とはいえ、
こうも人けがないと聞き込みが捗らないわね

localizations.en: I guess that makes sense. Though with so few people around, we're not making much progress gathering information.

999008199.text:
あっ！　ちょっとすみません！
おおお、お尋ねしたいことがあるんですが……！

localizations.en: Excuse me! Hello! I'd like to ask you some questions...!

999008199.text: タイニーはそれでも、手を抜かないのね

localizations.en: Tiny never takes it easy, does she?

999008199.text:
……そうですか。
ありがとうございました、お気を付けて

localizations.en: ...I see. Thank you very much. Please take care out here.

999008199.text: 特に知らないそうです。また空振りでしたね～

localizations.en: They didn't know anything either. Another dead end...

999008199.text:
タイニー、気持ちは分かるけど、そんなに鼻息を
荒くしてたら犯人じゃなくても逃げ出しちまうよ

localizations.en: I get that you're eager, Tiny, but if you're breathing down people's necks like that, they'll run away even if they're not criminals.

999008199.text: うっ……必死なの、出ちゃってます？

localizations.en: Ugh... Is my desperation really that obvious?

999008199.text:
そりゃもう全身から。
にじみ出まくり、醸し出しまくり

localizations.en: Oh yeah. You're practically radiating it from head to toe.

999008199.text:
うぅ、ボスみたいに鉄仮面になれれば
いいんですけど……修行不足です、無念！

localizations.en: If only I could put on a poker face like my boss... I still have so much training to do. How frustrating!

999008199.text:
ねえ、タイニーの捜査に昼より熱が入ったのって
やっぱり賞金首の「ヌルスラの鷹」が原因？

localizations.en: Hey, Tiny, is the reason you've been so intense about this investigation since this afternoon because of that bounty—the "Hawk of Nurslath"?

999008199.text:
同郷出身者のやらかしってのは
やっぱりこたえるもんだろうしねぇ

localizations.en: Having someone from your hometown causing trouble must sting pretty bad, I imagine.

999008199.text: ……はい、それもあると思います

localizations.en: ...Yes, I think that's part of it.

999008199.text:
ヌルスラって本当はどんなとこなの？
治安が悪かったって話だったけど

localizations.en: What's Nurslath really like? You mentioned the public order was bad there.

999008199.text:
そうですね……私が小さい頃なんかは
確かに酷かったです……

localizations.en: Well... When I was little, it really was terrible...

999008199.text:
昼でも夜でも、どこか燃えてて……
日々の食べ物にも困る有様でしたから

localizations.en: Day or night, something was always burning somewhere... We struggled just to find enough food to eat each day.

999008199.text:
アタシも仕事柄、そういう地域をそれなりに
見てきたけれど……大体が散々なものだった

localizations.en: I've seen my share of places like that in my line of work... and they're all pretty much nightmares.

999008199.text:
生きるために盗みや放火も正当化され、
それは子どもだって例外じゃない……

localizations.en: When people justify theft and arson just to survive, even children aren't exempt from that...

999008199.text:
はい。でも、そんな島でも私を守って、
世話してくれた近所のお兄ちゃんがいて……

localizations.en: Yes. But even on that island, there was someone who protected me and took care of me—a young man from the neighborhood...

999008199.text: ギヨームという名前なんですけど

今の私があるのもお兄ちゃんのおかげなんです。
でも、ある時離れ離れになってしまいました

localizations.en: I owe who I am today to him. But at some point, we got separated.

999008199.text:
こうして監察官になったのも、色んな島を回れるから
監察のついでにお兄ちゃんも見つかるかなって……

localizations.en: Part of why I became an inspector was because I'd be traveling to different islands... I thought maybe I could find him while I was working.

999008199.text: そっか……それがタイニーの夢なんだ

localizations.en: I see... So that's your dream.

999008199.text:
はい。もちろん、ボスみたいな立派な監察官になって
諸島同盟の秩序を守るってのも夢ですけど

localizations.en: Yes. Of course, I also dream of becoming a great inspector like my boss and upholding order throughout the Archipelago Federation.

999008199.text:
夢は１つだけじゃなきゃいけないって
決まりはないしね。叶うといいね

localizations.en: There's no rule saying you can only have one dream. I hope they both come true.

999008199.text:
はい！　話したら余計にやる気が出てきました！
頑張らないと！　より燃えてきました！

localizations.en: Thank you! Talking about it has made me even more motivated! I've got to give it my all! I'm fired up now!

999008199.text:
タイニーは、やりたいことがすでに決まってて
それに向かって一直線って感じね

localizations.en: You already know what you want to do and you're charging straight toward it. That's pretty impressive.

999008199.text:
……お前さんだって、やりたいこと、
見つかったんだろ？　十分立派さ

localizations.en: ...You've found what you want to do too, haven't you? That's plenty admirable in itself.

999008199.text:
……ん、そう言ってもらえると嬉しいかも。
タイニーもお兄ちゃんに会えるといいんだけど

localizations.en: ...Yeah, hearing you say that makes me happy. I hope Tiny gets to see Guillaume again.

999008199.text:
そうだね。でもあんまり深入りするのも
野暮ってもんだよ？

localizations.en: Me too. But let's not pry too much. That'd be tactless.

999008199.text: はいはい、分かってる分かってる。

ようし捜査再開と……
あれ？　燃えていたタイニーの嬢ちゃんはどこだい？

localizations.en: All right, let's get back to the investigation... Huh? Where'd our fired-up little inspector go?

999008199.text:
見失った！？　行方不明事件の捜査官が
行方不明になったんじゃシャレにならないっての！

localizations.en: We lost her?! If the inspector investigating the disappearances goes missing herself, that's beyond a joke!
